title: Generator Skill Anatomy Explorer
description: An explorer of the microsim-generator skill's four parts — the SKILL.md entry file, 17 reference guides, template asset folders and six utility scripts — that traces, for one of six sample requests, which parts enter the agent's working context and in what order, while unread guides and template folders stay grey.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Educational Technology
AI-Assisted Content Generation
MicroSim Engineering
AI Agent Skills

educational.audience: Teachers, instructional designers, learning-technology developers and learning-analytics practitioners
educational.topic: Structure of the MicroSim generator skill
learningObjectives: The learner will differentiate the entry file, reference guides, template assets and utility scripts of the generator skill by tracing which parts an agent reads for a given request.
prerequisites: Keyword routing and the MicroSim type catalog
What an AI skill and an agent are

dependencies: data.json (template folder file lists, loaded with fetch)

accessibility.screenReaderDescription: describe() explains the four boxes, the trace and the click-for-why panel

controls.label: Request
options: A bar chart of survey results

controls.label: Trace
controls.action: Highlight the parts the agent reads for the selected request, numbered in order

controls.label: Box or file square
controls.action: Open a panel explaining why the agent needs (or skips) that part

simulation.modelType: Routing trace over a static folder structure
assumptions: Request-to-guide mapping follows the routing table and decision tree in the skill's SKILL.md.
A single-MicroSim request uses the Step 1B route, so the chapter-only scripts are not run.
limitations: Line counts and file lists reflect the skill as of 2026-09-30 and will drift as the skill changes.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Guided exploration with comparison across requests
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Explorer with trace and click-for-detail (Analyze level)
keyQuestions: Which parts of the skill are read for every request, and which change with the request?
What does a reference guide give the agent that a template asset does not?
Why are the utility scripts run but not read?
commonMisconceptions: The agent reads every guide in the skill for every request.
The utility scripts are part of the agent's prompt.
assessmentOpportunities: Record the guide and template folder for all six requests
Predict the parts loaded for a new request and justify the grey squares
